CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_LIMITLIABILITYSANCTION_LNS
AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction
AS(
SELECT
BLL.LIMIT_B2KID
,BLL.BANK_ID
,BLL.LIM_SANCT_DATE
,BLL.SANCT_LIM
,BLL.ORIG_SANCT_LIM
,BLL.LIMIT_DESC
,BLL.SANCT_AUTH_CODE
,BLL.SANCT_LEVL_CODE
,BLL.INSERT_DTTM
,BLLD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.LNS_LIMITLIAB_DELTA BLLD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.LNS_LIMITLIAB BLL ON BLL.LIMIT_B2KID = BLLD.LIMIT_B2KID AND BLL.BANK_ID = BLLD.BANK_ID AND BLL.ISLATEST ='1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction FROM TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
LIMIT_B2KID
,BANK_ID
,LIM_SANCT_DATE
,SANCT_LIM
,ORIG_SANCT_LIM
,LIMIT_DESC
,SANCT_AUTH_CODE
,SANCT_LEVL_CODE
)) HASHROW, LIMIT_B2KID, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),


TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
LimitId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,LimSanctDate
,SanctLim
,OrigSanctLim
,LimitDesc
,SanctAuthCode
,SanctionLevlCode
)) HASHROW, LimitId
FROM BNKM.LimitLiabilitySanction
),

TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.LIMIT_B2KID, TGT.LimitId) AS LimitId
,CASE
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
    ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction_TGT TGT
ON SRC.LIMIT_B2KID = TGT.LimitId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT
SET
LimitId = SRC.LIMIT_B2KID
,FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.BANK_ID
,LimSanctDate = SRC.LIM_SANCT_DATE
,SanctLim = SRC.SANCT_LIM
,OrigSanctLim = SRC.ORIG_SANCT_LIM
,LimitDesc = SRC.LIMIT_DESC
,SanctAuthCode = SRC.SANCT_AUTH_CODE
,SanctionLevlCode = SRC.SANCT_LEVL_CODE
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'LNS'
,WORKFLOWID = 0
,TASKRUNID = 0
,INSERTDTTM = SRC.INSERT_DTTM

FROM BNKM.LimitLiabilitySanction TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.LimitId = TGT.LimitId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction SRC ON SRC.LIMIT_B2KID = TGT.LimitId;


--INSERT RECORD TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.LimitLiabilitySanction
(
LimitId
,FinancialInstitutionId
,LimSanctDate
,SanctLim
,OrigSanctLim
,LimitDesc
,SanctAuthCode
,SanctionLevlCode
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT
LIMIT_B2KID AS LimitId
,BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
,LIM_SANCT_DATE AS LimSanctDate
,SANCT_LIM AS SanctLim
,ORIG_SANCT_LIM AS OrigSanctLim
,LIMIT_DESC AS LimitDesc
,SANCT_AUTH_CODE AS SanctAuthCode
,SANCT_LEVL_CODE AS SanctionLevlCode
,'LNS' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_LimitLiabilitySanction_DELTA;

END
